records.title: penetrationFromStacks never stamped on metal basic - Kim Liet pierce scaling dead

records.title: Empowered (Phap The) variant dropped theGainOnLandedCast - empowered casts granted 0 The

records.expected: spec D2 / INV-1: empowered cast still mints +1 The.
records.fix: Stamp moved BEFORE buildPhapTheVariant(element, stamped) so {...base} inherits it.

records.title: boundToSourceBuffId markers outlive window by one runPhaseB boundary
records.counterexample: Bound sweep precedes decrement/expiry; a window expiring in the same pass leaves markers alive one boundary - stale sinh_co could feed applyPeriodicGrowth.
records.expected: spec D10: marker dies the moment source no longer holds the window.
records.fix: runPhaseB (5b): bound re-sweep after expiry step retires orphaned markers immediately.

records.title: THE_BAR_MAX literal 5 duplicated canonical SPELL_PATH_MAX_THE
records.counterexample: Second hard-coded 5 on the presentation side; two edit points for one rule.

records.title: AoE secondary onLanded effects fired per-target instead of once-per-cast
records.counterexample: secondary deal_damage/buff lanes authored oncePerCast fired on every hit target; AoE multi-hit stacked consequences.
records.expected: flagged secondary fires at most once per cast regardless of hit count.
records.fix: priorLandedHitOpIds accumulator -> ops_landed_any read on this lane's priors -> flagged secondary wrapped in branch{var lt 1}; + SNAPSHOT BUG found by pin test: reference capture let later lanes poison the read - fixed via operationIds:[...priors]; pin test asserts exact other-lane id coverage.

records.title: Ho The DR unclamped - could exceed cap when mp pool anomalies
selectSpellPathElement had no mid-battle guard - element switchable during combat
records.counterexample: Element commit callable while a turn battle was live - swaps the resolved basic mid-fight.
records.expected: commit blocked while battle in progress (matches other path ops).

records.title: theGainOnLandedCast grant emitted per execution (follow-up repeats/multicast) not per cast
records.counterexample: emitGrants fired on every spawned follow-up execution, so multicast/repeat plans minted extra The.
records.expected: grant per cast ACTION (root plan only).
records.fix: emitGrants early-returns when plan.subcastIndex > 0 (composite extras already suppressed via flag).

records.title: Coordinator-found: ops_landed_any read captured priorLandedHitOpIds BY REFERENCE - later lanes poisoned the dedup var
records.discoveredBy: coordinator pin test (SkillResolver.test.ts oncePerCast lane coverage)
records.counterexample: The accumulating array was referenced, not copied: lane B's own pushed hit id entered the read -> secondary suppressed even when lane A missed.
records.expected: read must pin THIS lane's priors only.
records.fix: operationIds: [...priorLandedHitOpIds] snapshot + comment; pin test asserts reads.get(opcastVar) equals OTHER lane's hit ids exactly.

records.title: Comment mojibake + splice damage during ascii-ratchet transliteration sweep
